facts.fact: The digital transition ministry (MTNRA) states that it is working with the Ministry of Health and Social Protection and the CNSS on setting up a shared medical record for medical follow-up, preparing data reference frameworks, UX/UI design and change management for adoption by health professionals and patients; the page gives no date for this, so the published date (itself inferred) is used.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de la Protection Sociale, with MTNRA support

note: Both health systems are described as projects being set up; no tier, coverage or digitisation point is stated. The electronic claim form is for reimbursement, outside the classes.
